title: Went from silky and soft to looking like a murdered muppet after washing
text:
Went from silky and soft to looking like a murdered muppet after washing. *update*
After my cat vomited on the rug I had to wash it. I followed the washing instructions, then laid it out to dry. Now instead of being silly and soft, it looks like I murdered a Muppet.

I figured it would have about the same thickness as a bathroom memory foam mat, but this is so thin I would be surprised if there was any cushion at all. I gave it a full day to warm up from the cold and still nothing.
That said, the shag is very soft and nice on my feet. It's a beautiful color and for the money, it's a fairly nice rug. It should easily fit in the wash and i'm fairly happy with the purchase. I would like a thicker rug for the winter, but this was cheap enough to be a nice decoration for the guest bedroom.
